title: Diane Powell meets Akil after his mother saw her interviewed by Deepak Chopra

tellings.quote: contacting me after seeing me um being interviewed by deepo tro

plain: In 2022 a mother named Manisha in New Jersey saw Diane Powell, a researcher who studies children said to read minds, being interviewed by the writer Deepak Chopra, and got in touch with her. Powell says this is how she came to meet Manisha's son Akil, one of the children she studies. She tells it as the start of her own work with the boy.
